about: Every good and bad agent.yml case, and the verdict of each of its three readers:
PyYAML with the schema (tests/gates/test_agent_yml.py; `problems` are fragments of its problems, [] = accepted),
the stdlib reader of the graph (tests/support/harness_agents.py; the same verdict unless `subset` says otherwise),
js-yaml with agent.js, the reader of the image build (tests/agents/_shared/plugins/dsh-plugin-app-tools/tools.test.mjs;
the same verdict unless `agent_js` says otherwise). Every exception says why. A real agent.yml must pass all three.
